combo_label: The Office × The Olympics × The Wizard of Oz

entries.clue: Numbered list of items to be got through, circulated before anyone sits down
Yellow-brick way the lost girl is told to follow, and to keep on following
Fellow member of staff, allotted to you rather than chosen
Five interlocking circles on the flag, and a gymnast's hanging apparatus
Plucky little cairn terrier who leaps out of the basket and runs for home
Light track shoes whose metal pins bite into the surface
Ribboned disc, minted in three metals, hung round a winner's neck
Green gem that gives the glittering city at the end of the bricks its name
Heavy handled beaker holding a proper amount of tea, not a dainty cupful
Sprung jaw that punches a wire fastener through a wad of sheets and bends it flat
Dusty holding of pigs, chickens and three hired hands that the girl is torn from
Competitor in vest and pinned-on number, lodged in the village
Howling blow that sends the whole household scrambling down into the cellar
